title: SIM replacement
disclaimer: FICTIONAL TRAINING CONTENT. Created for Fictional Telecom Lab; does not represent any real provider or legal requirement. Knowledge guidance only; no customer actions can be performed.

sections.heading: Appointments and scope
sections.text: For this fictional consumer service, a physical SIM replacement does not require an appointment. An optional booking may help plan a visit. A lost, stolen or damaged SIM can be discussed with an authorised store colleague; this guidance does not itself replace or deactivate a SIM.

sections.heading: Required checks
sections.text: Before any replacement, an authorised colleague must follow IDV-1001 for identity requirements and AUTH-1001 for account authority. A bill or knowledge of a phone number is not evidence of authority. If either policy is absent from the retrieved evidence, the copilot cannot confirm eligibility.

sections.heading: Choosing physical SIM or eSIM
sections.text: For a digital SIM, use ESIM-1001 to check device readiness. The same identity and authority requirements still apply. The copilot cannot issue activation codes or promise an activation time.
